description.text: Main Courses: Clinical Practice in Internal Medicine of TCM, Gynecology of TCM, Surgery of TCM, Pediatrics of TCM, Orthopedics of TCM, Dermatology of TCM, Acupuncture, Tuina, etc.

duration.text: The Clinical Studies of TCM at Beijing University of Chinese Medicine is a 3 Months long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/In total ￥ 20000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of highest education 5.Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: 1.Licensed physicians of Chinese or Western medicine, acupuncturist, or senior students or graduates of medical schools, those who are interested in Chinese medicine could apply for short-term courses 2.Healthy
